column1: # version 0.7 (reference-aware prototype: version 0.6 + 12 phased_ref1 rows; diploid_tokens.tsv and _v2 unchanged)
# symmetric -> Homozygous for a given allele at this position
# unphased -> Heterozygous for a given allele at this position, but phasing is not given
# phased   -> Heterozygous for a given allele at this position, taking phasing into consideration
# single   -> (proposed) representation for hemizygous (single X or Y)
# homalt   -> (v2 input only) Homozygous for a NON-reference base at this position (SNV).
#             Written by pretrain/v2_input.py from the stored `^` + base; the dataset on disk never holds it.
# phased_ref1 -> (prototype, pretrain/v2_input.py with a reference) Heterozygous SNV, phased, with the REFERENCE
#             base on copy 1 (VCF 1|0). Pair = (copy 0 base, copy 1 base). The `phased` rows then mean
#             reference on copy 0 (VCF 0|1). Circled digits: single codepoints with no case mapping.
